#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay semantics tests: quarantine precedence, evidence, isolation."""
import hashlib, ipaddress, json, os, subprocess, sys

SUB = "/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py"
WORK = "/workspace/scratch/work2"
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
fails = []

def canary(seed, w, s, net64):
    p = ("ipv6-evidence-v1\n%d\n%s\n%s\n%s\n" % (seed, w, s, net64)).encode("ascii")
    c0 = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(p).digest()[:8], "big") | (1 << 63)
    return c0, c0 ^ 1

def A(x):
    return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))

def write(name, data):
    p = os.path.join(WORK, name)
    mode = "wb" if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)) else "w"
    open(p, mode).write(data)
    return p

def replay(manifest, rows):
    mp = write("m.json", json.dumps(manifest))
    rp = write("r.jsonl", "\n".join(rows) + ("\n" if rows else ""))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return None, p
    return json.loads(p.stdout), p

def check(label, cond, extra=""):
    if not cond:
        fails.append(label)
        print("FAIL[%s] %s" % (label, extra))

MAN = {
    "version": 1, "seed": 5, "low_count": 3, "attempts": 2,
    "spacing_ms": 10, "timeout_ms": 100,
    "windows": [
        {"id": "w1", "start_ms": 1000, "scopes": [
            {"id": "s1", "prefix": "2001:db8:1:2::/64", "subnets": [0]}]},
        {"id": "w2", "start_ms": 1000, "scopes": [
            {"id": "s1", "prefix": "2001:db8:1:2::/64", "subnets": [0]}]},
    ],
}
C0, C1 = canary(5, "w1", "s1", "2001:db8:1:2::/64")
C0W2, C1W2 = canary(5, "w2", "s1", "2001:db8:1:2::/64")
BASE = int(ipaddress.IPv6Address("2001:db8:1:2::"))
T1, T2, T3 = A(BASE | 1), A(BASE | 2), A(BASE | 3)
CAN0, CAN1 = A(BASE | C0), A(BASE | C1)
CAN0W2, CAN1W2 = A(BASE | C0W2), A(BASE | C1W2)

def row(pid, recv, tgt, src, t=129, c=0):
    return json.dumps({"probe_id": pid, "received_ms": recv, "target": tgt,
                       "source": src, "type": t, "code": c})

# ---------------- quarantine precedence ----------------
cases = [
    ("json", ["{not json"]),
    ("json", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "bogus", "bogus", 999, 999).replace('"type":999', '"type":999')]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0"})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0", "received_ms": 1000, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0, "extra": 1})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": 5, "received_ms": 1000, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0", "received_ms": 1000, "target": 5,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "", "received_ms": 1000, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "x"*201, "received_ms": 1000, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0", "received_ms": 1.5, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0", "received_ms": True, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": 129, "code": 0})]),
    ("schema", [json.dumps({"probe_id": "w1/s1/0/low-1/0", "received_ms": 1000, "target": T1,
                            "source": T1, "type": True, "code": 0})]),
    ("address", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "2001:db8::1%eth0", T1)]),
    ("address", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "not-an-address", T1)]),
    ("address", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "2002:db8::1", T1)]),
    ("address", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "::1", T1)]),
    ("address", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, "2001:db8::1 ")]),
    ("unknown_probe", [row("w1/s1/0/low-99/0", 1000, T1, T1)]),
    ("unknown_probe", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0 ", 1000, T1, T1)]),
    ("target_mismatch", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T2, T1)]),
    ("time", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 999, T1, T1)]),
    ("time", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1100, T1, T1)]),
    ("icmp", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1, 128, 0)]),
    ("icmp", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1, 1, 7)]),
    ("icmp", [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1, 129, 1)]),
]
for expected, rows in cases:
    res, p = replay(MAN, rows)
    if res is None:
        check("precedence %s rc" % expected, False, p.stderr[:200])
        continue
    got = res["diagnostics"]
    check("precedence %s" % expected,
          len(got) == 1 and got[0]["reason"] == expected and got[0]["line"] == 1,
          "got %r" % (got,))
    check("precedence %s accepted" % expected, res["accepted_rows"] == 0 and res["duplicate_rows"] == 0)

# nonfinite / BOM / dup keys in a row -> json
for raw in ['{"version":NaN}', '﻿{}', '{"a":1,"a":2}', '{"a":1e400}']:
    res, p = replay(MAN, [raw])
    check("row json %r" % raw[:20], res is not None and res["diagnostics"] == [{"line": 1, "reason": "json"}],
          repr(res["diagnostics"] if res else p.stderr[:200]))

# blank line counts as a row
res, _ = replay(MAN, ["", row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1)])
check("blank line", res["diagnostics"] == [{"line": 1, "reason": "json"}] and res["accepted_rows"] == 1,
      repr(res["diagnostics"]))

# ---------------- evidence ----------------
# internal reply for target 1, external error for target 2 (source outside /64)
ext_src = "2001:db8:ffff::a"
rows = [
    row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1),                  # internal attempt 0
    row("w1/s1/0/low-2/1", 1030, T2, ext_src, 1, 1),       # external attempt 1
    row("w1/s1/0/low-3/0", 1040, T3, T3, 129, 0),           # internal attempt 0
    row("w1/s1/0/low-3/1", 1050, T3, "2001:db8:9::5", 129, 0),  # anomalous wrong-source echo
]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("ev accepted", res["accepted_rows"] == 4, repr(res["accepted_rows"]))
check("ev state", seg["state"] == "usable", seg["state"])
check("ev exposure", seg["exposure"] == "observed_internal_reply", seg["exposure"])
check("ev internal", seg["internal"] == [T1, T3], repr(seg["internal"]))
check("ev external", seg["external"] == [ext_src], repr(seg["external"]))
check("ev overlap", seg["overlap"] == [])
t = seg["targets"]
check("ev t1", t[0] == {"address": T1, "classification": "internal", "internal_attempts": [0],
                         "external_attempts": [], "external_sources": [], "silent_attempts": [1]}, repr(t[0]))
check("ev t2", t[1] == {"address": T2, "classification": "external", "internal_attempts": [],
                         "external_attempts": [1], "external_sources": [ext_src], "silent_attempts": [0]}, repr(t[1]))
check("ev t3", t[2] == {"address": T3, "classification": "internal", "internal_attempts": [0],
                         "external_attempts": [], "external_sources": [], "silent_attempts": []}, repr(t[2]))

# mixed
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1), row("w1/s1/0/low-1/1", 1010, T1, ext_src, 1, 0)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("mixed cls", seg["targets"][0]["classification"] == "mixed", repr(seg["targets"][0]))
check("mixed overlap", seg["overlap"] == [])
check("mixed internal", seg["internal"] == [T1])
check("mixed external", seg["external"] == [ext_src])

# overlap -> ambiguous: T1 replies internally and also appears as an error source
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1), row("w1/s1/0/low-2/0", 1020, T2, T1, 1, 3)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("ambiguous state", seg["state"] == "ambiguous", seg["state"])
check("ambiguous exposure", seg["exposure"] == "excluded", seg["exposure"])
check("ambiguous overlap", seg["overlap"] == [T1], repr(seg["overlap"]))
check("ambiguous cls", seg["targets"][0]["classification"] == "ambiguous", repr(seg["targets"][0]))
check("ambiguous cls2", seg["targets"][1]["classification"] == "ambiguous")

# canary hits -> alias_suspect
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/canary-0/0", 1060, CAN0, CAN0), row("w1/s1/0/canary-1/0", 1080, CAN1, CAN1)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("alias state", seg["state"] == "alias_suspect", seg["state"])
check("alias exposure", seg["exposure"] == "excluded", seg["exposure"])
check("alias hits", seg["canary_hits"] == [0, 1], repr(seg["canary_hits"]))
check("alias cls", seg["targets"][0]["classification"] == "alias_suspect")
check("alias silent", seg["targets"][0]["silent_attempts"] == [0, 1], repr(seg["targets"][0]))

# only one canary hit -> usable
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/canary-0/0", 1060, CAN0, CAN0)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("one canary state", seg["state"] == "usable", seg["state"])
check("one canary hits", seg["canary_hits"] == [0])

# canary error does not count as hit, but is a retained response
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/canary-0/0", 1060, CAN0, "2001:db8:5::9", 1, 0)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
seg = res["segments"][0]
check("canary err no hit", seg["canary_hits"] == [], repr(seg["canary_hits"]))
check("canary err no external", seg["external"] == [], repr(seg["external"]))
check("canary err accepted", res["accepted_rows"] == 1)

# window isolation: w2 canary differs and rows do not cross
rows = [row("w2/s1/0/canary-0/0", 1060, CAN0W2, CAN0W2), row("w2/s1/0/canary-1/0", 1080, CAN1W2, CAN1W2)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
check("iso w1 clean", res["segments"][0]["state"] == "usable" and res["segments"][0]["canary_hits"] == [],
      repr(res["segments"][0]))
check("iso w2 alias", res["segments"][1]["state"] == "alias_suspect", repr(res["segments"][1]["state"]))
check("seg count", len(res["segments"]) == 2)

# duplicate detection with different spellings
rows = [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1),
        row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, "2001:0DB8:0001:0002:0000:0000:0000:0001", "2001:db8:1:2::1"),
        row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1)]
res, _ = replay(MAN, rows)
check("dup counts", res["accepted_rows"] == 1 and res["duplicate_rows"] == 2,
      repr((res["accepted_rows"], res["duplicate_rows"])))

# empty log
res, _ = replay(MAN, [])
check("empty log", res["accepted_rows"] == 0 and res["duplicate_rows"] == 0 and res["diagnostics"] == [])
check("empty log segs", len(res["segments"]) == 2)
check("empty log silent", res["segments"][0]["targets"][0]["silent_attempts"] == [0, 1])
check("empty log exposure", res["segments"][0]["exposure"] == "inconclusive")
check("empty log state", res["segments"][0]["state"] == "usable")

# order independence
rows_a = [row("w1/s1/0/low-1/0", 1000, T1, T1), row("w1/s1/0/low-2/0", 1020, T2, ext_src, 1, 1)]
rows_b = list(reversed(rows_a))
r1, _ = replay(MAN, rows_a)
r2, _ = replay(MAN, rows_b)
check("order independent", r1 == r2)

print("replay failures:", len(fails), fails)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/scratch && python3 t_replay.py
